items.q_id: Apakah hukum ketenagakerjaan melindungi anda?

items.q_id: Apakah anda harus mendapat kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang anda pahami?
items.q_en: Must you get a written contract in a language you understand?

items.a_en: Written contract required, no language rule
items.note_en: Written contract for the work permit.

items.q_id: Apakah upah minimum berlaku bagi anda?
items.q_en: Does a minimum wage apply to you?
items.do_id: Pastikan jumlah upah tertulis di kontrak.
items.do_en: Make sure the wage is written in the contract.
items.a_id: Tidak ada upah minimum
items.a_en: No minimum wage
items.note_en: Minimum Wages Order excludes domestic employees.

items.q_id: Apakah upah harus dibayar rutin dan tercatat?
items.q_en: Must your wage be paid regularly and on record?
items.do_id: Catat setiap pembayaran upah: tanggal, jumlah, dan potongan.
items.do_en: Write down every payment: date, amount and deductions.
items.a_id: Pembayaran berkala wajib, tanpa pengaman lain
items.a_en: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
items.note_en: Wage payment rules partly apply.

items.q_id: Apakah jam kerja anda dibatasi?
items.q_en: Are your working hours limited?
items.do_id: Catat jam mulai dan selesai kerja setiap hari.
items.do_en: Write down when you start and stop work each day.
items.a_id: Tidak ada batas dan aturan istirahat harian
items.a_en: No limit and no daily rest rule
items.note_en: Hours provisions do not apply.

items.q_id: Apakah anda berhak libur mingguan?
items.q_en: Do you have a right to a weekly day off?
items.do_id: Pastikan hari libur tertulis di kontrak.
items.do_en: Make sure your day off is written in the contract.
items.a_id: Tidak ada istirahat mingguan
items.a_en: No weekly rest
items.note_en: Rest-day provisions do not apply.

items.q_id: Apakah anda berhak cuti tahunan dibayar?
items.q_en: Do you have a right to paid annual leave?
items.do_id: Tanyakan berapa hari cuti anda per tahun.
items.do_en: Ask how many days of leave you get each year.
items.a_id: Tidak ada
items.a_en: None
items.note_en: Annual leave provisions do not apply.

items.q_id: Apakah anda boleh menyimpan paspor sendiri?
items.q_en: May you keep your own passport?
items.do_id: Simpan foto paspor, visa, dan kontrak di HP dan kirim ke keluarga.
items.do_en: Keep photos of your passport, visa and contract on your phone and send them to your family.
items.a_id: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
items.a_en: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
items.note_en: Unlawful possession of another person's passport is an offence.

items.q_id: Apakah ada aturan tentang tempat tinggal dan privasi anda?
items.q_en: Are there rules on your living conditions and privacy?
items.do_id: Tanyakan di mana anda akan tidur dan apakah ada kamar sendiri.
items.do_en: Ask where you will sleep and whether you get your own room.
items.a_id: Tidak ada aturan
items.a_en: No rule
items.note_en: No rule.

items.q_id: Bisakah anda pindah majikan?
items.q_en: Can you change employer?
items.do_id: Jika tidak bisa pindah tanpa izin majikan, pastikan majikan dan pekerjaan sesuai janji sebelum berangkat.
items.do_en: If you cannot change without the employer's consent, check the employer and the job before you leave.
items.a_id: Pindah memerlukan persetujuan pemberi kerja
items.a_en: Change needs the employer's consent
items.note_en: Change needs the employer's consent.

items.q_id: Apakah biaya perekrutan dilarang di negara tujuan?
items.q_en: Are recruitment fees banned in the destination?
items.do_id: Jangan membayar agen di luar ketentuan. Minta kuitansi untuk setiap pembayaran.
items.do_en: Do not pay agents more than the rules allow. Get a receipt for every payment.
items.a_id: Biaya dibatasi
items.a_en: Fees capped
items.note_en: Fees regulated under the Private Employment Agencies Act.

items.q_id: Apakah agen harus berizin dan bertanggung jawab?
items.q_en: Must agencies be licensed and liable?
items.do_id: Catat nama dan nomor izin agen di Indonesia dan di negara tujuan.
items.do_en: Write down the name and licence number of the agency at home and abroad.
items.a_id: Hanya perizinan
items.a_en: Licensing only
items.note_en: Licensed agencies.

items.q_id: Apakah ada pengawasan ketenagakerjaan untuk pekerjaan anda?
items.q_en: Is there labor inspection for your job?
items.do_id: Simpan nomor kantor ketenagakerjaan setempat.
items.do_en: Keep the number of the local labor office.
items.a_id: Tidak ada pengawasan
items.a_en: No inspection
items.note_en: No household inspection.

items.q_id: Ke mana anda bisa mengadu jika ada sengketa?
items.q_en: Where can you complain if there is a dispute?
items.do_id: Simpan nomor pengaduan di bawah. Bukti tertulis membantu pengaduan anda.
items.do_en: Keep the complaint numbers below. Written evidence helps your complaint.
items.a_id: Hanya penyelesaian administratif, atau akses lebih sempit
items.a_en: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
items.note_en: Labour Court for wage claims.

items.q_id: Apakah anda mendapat jaminan sosial dan perlindungan kehamilan?
items.q_en: Do you get social security and maternity protection?
items.do_id: Tanyakan asuransi apa yang dibayar majikan.
items.do_en: Ask which insurance the employer pays for.
items.a_id: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
items.a_en: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
items.note_en: Employment injury scheme covers foreign domestic workers since 2021.

items.q_id: Apakah hukum melindungi anda dari kekerasan dan pelecehan?
items.q_en: Does the law protect you from abuse and harassment?
items.do_id: Jika terjadi kekerasan, cari tempat aman dan hubungi nomor di bawah.
items.do_en: If there is violence, get to a safe place and call a number below.
items.a_id: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum
items.a_en: General criminal or civil law only
items.note_en: General criminal law; anti-trafficking law.

items.q_id: Bolehkah anda bergabung dengan serikat atau perkumpulan pekerja?
items.q_en: May you join a union or workers' association?
items.do_id: Cari perkumpulan pekerja Indonesia di kota tujuan.
items.do_en: Look for an Indonesian workers' association in the city you go to.
items.a_id: Belum jelas
items.note_en: Not determined.

items.q_id: Apakah undang-undang ketenagakerjaan berlaku bagi anda?
items.q_en: Does the labor statute apply to you?
items.do_id: Tanyakan undang-undang mana yang mengatur pekerjaan anda, dan simpan namanya.
items.do_en: Ask which law covers your job and keep its name.
items.a_id: UU ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku penuh
items.a_en: The general labor statute applies in full
items.note_en: The Employment Act applies in full to manual workers whatever their wage (First Schedule para 1, as substituted from 1 Jan 2023), including in agricultural undertakings. Estate workers paid by the day are guaranteed work on at least 24 days a month (s. 16). Act 446 sets housing and amenity standards for estates over 20 ha. Peninsular only; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.
items.src: Employment Act 1955 ss. 2, 60K (Act A1651, 2022); Sabah Labour Ordinance (Cap. 67) · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf

items.q_id: Apakah upah minimum berlaku bagi anda?
items.q_en: Does a minimum wage apply to you?
items.do_id: Pastikan jumlah upah tertulis di kontrak.
items.do_en: Make sure the wage is written in the contract.
items.a_id: Upah minimum nasional berlaku
items.a_en: The national statutory minimum wage applies
items.note_en: The national minimum wage (RM1,700 a month from 1 Feb 2025; from 1 Aug 2025 for employers with fewer than five workers) applies with no exclusion for agriculture or for foreign workers. Piece-rate and tonnage workers must also receive at least RM1,700.
items.src: National Wages Consultative Council Act 2011 (Act 732); Minimum Wages Order 2024 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputp/2541500/PUA%20376.pdf

items.q_id: Apakah jam kerja dan waktu istirahat anda dibatasi?
items.q_en: Are your working hours and rest protected?
items.do_id: Catat jam mulai dan selesai kerja setiap hari.
items.do_en: Write down when you start and stop work each day.
items.a_id: Batas jam kerja menurut undang-undang berlaku
items.a_en: Statutory limits on hours apply
items.note_en: Limits of 8 hours a day and 45 a week (lowered from 48 by Act A1651) apply, with no exclusion for agriculture. The Director General may allow longer hours on application (s. 60A(1A)), and the Minister may exempt by order (s. 2B).
items.src: Employment Act 1955 s. 60A (as amended 2022) · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf

items.q_id: Bisakah anda pindah majikan?
items.q_en: Can you change employer?
items.do_id: Jika tidak bisa pindah tanpa izin majikan, pastikan majikan dan pekerjaan sesuai janji sebelum berangkat.
items.do_en: If you cannot change without the employer's consent, check the employer and the job before you leave.
items.a_id: Tidak bisa pindah tanpa izin majikan
items.a_en: Cannot change without the employer's consent
items.note_en: Each employer needs the Director General's prior approval to employ a foreign employee (Employment Act s. 60K), and must report when the worker leaves, absconding included (s. 60KA). A pass stops being valid once its conditions are breached (Immigration Act s. 55B(2)). The rule tying the Visit Pass (Temporary Employment) to one employer, and any transfer procedure, sit in the Immigration Regulations 1963 and in Immigration Department practice, neither readable on the trusted sites. items.a_en: May join but faces legal limits, or residence status makes membership largely theoretical
items.note_en: Non-citizens may join a union but may not be, or act as, members of a union executive (s. 28(1)(a)) or be employed by a union (s. 29(2)(a)). LOM lists a 12 Jan 2024 instrument for this Act that could not be opened.

items.q_id: Apakah biaya perekrutan dilarang di negara tujuan?
items.q_en: Are recruitment fees banned in the destination?
items.do_id: Jangan membayar agen di luar ketentuan. Minta kuitansi untuk setiap pembayaran.
items.do_en: Do not pay agents more than the rules allow. Get a receipt for every payment.
items.a_id: Biaya yang dibebankan kepada pekerja dibatasi atau diatur
items.a_en: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
items.note_en: Agencies may charge a non-citizen employee no more than one month's basic wage as a placement fee; if the employer pays, nothing may be taken from the worker (s. 14B(3)). Overcharging is an offence (s. 28). Fees charged in sending states are outside the Act.
items.src: Private Employment Agencies Act 1981 (Act 246), as amended 2017; National Action Plan on Forced Labour 2021–2025 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/3165320_BI/Act%20246%20(REPRINT%202018).pdf

items.q_id: Apakah anda didaftarkan dalam asuransi sosial?
items.q_en: Are you enrolled in social insurance?
items.do_id: Tanyakan asuransi apa yang dibayar majikan, dan minta nomor kepesertaannya.
items.do_en: Ask which insurance the employer pays for and get the member number.
items.a_id: Didaftarkan dalam asuransi ketenagakerjaan atau kesehatan nasional
items.a_en: Enrolled in the national labor or health insurance schemes
items.note_en: Covered by SOCSO as employees in an industry. The Act excludes only foreign workers without a valid pass (First Schedule para (12A)). The date foreign workers were brought in (reported as 2019) and the schemes that apply were not confirmed from the texts read. Act A1788 (2026, not yet in force) adds non-employment injury cover, which a foreign worker loses for misusing a pass.

items.note_en: General Department of Labour offices and an online complaint system; plantations are often remote, and complaints require the worker's pass to be valid.

items.a_en: No route: fixed maximum stay, or time does not count
items.note_en: No route was found in the texts read. Permanent residence (Entry Permit, s. 10) is at the Director General's discretion; maximum stay rules for foreign workers sit in policy and regulations not readable on the trusted sites.

items.q_id: Bisakah anda pindah majikan?
items.q_en: Can you change employer?
items.do_id: Jika tidak bisa pindah tanpa izin majikan, pastikan majikan dan pekerjaan sesuai janji sebelum berangkat.

items.a_en: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
items.note_en: Transfer without the employer's consent in 12 listed cases (e.g. three unpaid wages, no residence permit, being hired out, dangerous work, abuse, employer's delay in a complaint); final exit at the end of the contract. No general right to change employer; the 2021 labour reforms exclude domestic workers.
items.src: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 27; MD 212875/1443; HRSD rules on the contractual relationship (2024) art. 5(3)

items.q_id: Apakah biaya perekrutan dilarang di negara tujuan?

items.a_en: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
items.note_en: The employer bears recruitment costs and fees; recruitment companies may not take any sum from the worker or receive payments outside the Musaned platform.
items.src: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 15(1); Recruitment Rules, MD 119698 (2025) arts 42, 50

items.a_en: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
items.note_en: Recruitment companies are licensed with bank guarantees (SAR 2-10 million by category) that the ministry may draw on for unpaid worker dues or return costs; the licensee is liable for the worker it placed and must house absent workers; replacement or refund during the 90-day probation.
items.src: Recruitment Rules, MD 119698 (2025) arts 8, 13, 46, 49, 53, 59; Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 9

items.a_en: Specific provisions with a remedy

items.a_id: Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
items.a_en: No right recognized in law
items.note_en: No provision in the regulation; migrant workers may not join workers' committees.
items.src: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445; CoM Decree 12/1422

items.q_id: Apakah hukum ketenagakerjaan melindungi anda?
items.q_en: Does labor law protect you?
items.do_id: Tanyakan undang-undang mana yang mengatur pekerjaan anda, dan simpan namanya.
items.do_en: Ask which law covers your job and keep its name.
items.a_id: Instrumen khusus dengan hak lebih sempit, atau hanya pasal tertentu dari hukum umum
items.a_en: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
items.note_en: Dedicated decree-law; the general labor law (FDL 33/2021) excludes domestic workers. Scope limited to occupations listed in the Executive Regulations.

items.q_id: Apakah anda harus mendapat kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang anda pahami?
items.q_en: Must you get a written contract in a language you understand?
items.do_id: Minta kontrak dalam bahasa Indonesia. Baca sebelum tanda tangan. Simpan fotonya di HP.
items.do_en: Ask for the contract in your language. Read it before signing. Keep a photo on your phone.
items.a_id: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja
items.a_en: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
items.note_en: Employment Agreement on the Ministry form, copy delivered to the worker; contracts and forms in Arabic plus a language the worker understands.

items.q_id: Apakah upah minimum berlaku bagi anda?
items.q_en: Does a minimum wage apply to you?
items.do_id: Pastikan jumlah upah tertulis di kontrak.
items.do_en: Make sure the wage is written in the contract.
items.a_id: Tidak ada upah minimum
items.a_en: No minimum wage
items.note_en: No statutory minimum wage. Art. 28(3) sets a minimum income for the employer, not a wage floor.

items.q_id: Apakah upah harus dibayar rutin dan tercatat?
items.q_en: Must your wage be paid regularly and on record?
items.do_id: Catat setiap pembayaran upah: tanggal, jumlah, dan potongan.
items.do_en: Write down every payment: date, amount and deductions.
items.a_id: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
items.a_en: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
items.note_en: Monthly wage in UAE dirhams within 10 days of the due date, proved by receipt; deductions capped at one quarter. Payment through the Wage Protection System is required for 5 domestic occupations and voluntary for the other 14.

items.q_id: Apakah jam kerja anda dibatasi?
items.q_en: Are your working hours limited?
items.do_id: Catat jam mulai dan selesai kerja setiap hari.
items.do_en: Write down when you start and stop work each day.
items.a_id: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
items.a_en: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
items.note_en: Daily rest of at least 12 hours, 8 of them consecutive (so at most 12 hours of work a day); no weekly limit and no overtime rule.

items.q_id: Apakah anda berhak libur mingguan?
items.q_en: Do you have a right to a weekly day off?
items.do_id: Pastikan hari libur tertulis di kontrak.
items.do_en: Make sure your day off is written in the contract.
items.a_id: Istirahat mingguan ada tetapi boleh diganti uang atau hari lain, atau lebih pendek
items.a_en: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
items.note_en: Paid weekly rest day; the worker may be required to work it for another rest day or a day's wage, but not on more than two consecutive rest days in two weeks unless agreed.

items.q_id: Apakah anda berhak cuti tahunan dibayar?
items.q_en: Do you have a right to paid annual leave?
items.do_id: Tanyakan berapa hari cuti anda per tahun.
items.do_en: Ask how many days of leave you get each year.
items.a_id: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
items.a_en: Equal to or longer than for other workers
items.note_en: At least 30 days' paid annual leave; return ticket every two years.

items.q_id: Apakah anda boleh menyimpan paspor sendiri?
items.q_en: May you keep your own passport?
items.do_id: Simpan foto paspor, visa, dan kontrak di HP dan kirim ke keluarga.
items.do_en: Keep photos of your passport, visa and contract on your phone and send them to your family.
items.a_id: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
items.a_en: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
items.note_en: Employer must ensure the worker's right to keep their own identification documents; withholding them carries a fine of AED 500.

items.q_id: Apakah ada aturan tentang tempat tinggal dan privasi anda?
items.q_en: Are there rules on your living conditions and privacy?
items.do_id: Tanyakan di mana anda akan tidur dan apakah ada kamar sendiri.
items.do_en: Ask where you will sleep and whether you get your own room.
items.a_id: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
items.a_en: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
items.note_en: Employer must provide suitable accommodation; no rule on living out.

items.q_id: Bisakah anda pindah majikan?
items.q_en: Can you change employer?
items.do_id: Jika tidak bisa pindah tanpa izin majikan, pastikan majikan dan pekerjaan sesuai janji sebelum berangkat.
items.do_en: If you cannot change without the employer's consent, check the employer and the job before you leave.
items.a_id: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
items.a_en: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
items.note_en: Transfer during the contract needs the employer's written consent and Ministry approval; without consent only after a judicial decision that the employer breached its obligations, or immediately in cases of assault (reported to the authorities). No exit permit is required.
items.src: FDL 9/2022 arts 20-21; Ministerial Resolution 674/2022 art. 2; Cabinet Resolution 106/2022

items.q_id: Apakah biaya perekrutan dilarang di negara tujuan?

items.do_id: Jangan membayar agen di luar ketentuan. Minta kuitansi untuk setiap pembayaran.
items.do_en: Do not pay agents more than the rules allow. Get a receipt for every payment.
items.a_id: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
items.a_en: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
items.note_en: Agencies may not demand or accept any commission or expenses from the worker; employers may not take any amount from the worker.

items.q_id: Apakah agen harus berizin dan bertanggung jawab?
items.q_en: Must agencies be licensed and liable?
items.do_id: Catat nama dan nomor izin agen di Indonesia dan di negara tujuan.
items.do_en: Write down the name and licence number of the agency at home and abroad.
items.a_id: Agen berizin dan bertanggung jawab kepada pekerja (pengembalian, biaya pulang atau tanggung renteng)
items.a_en: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
items.note_en: Licensing by the Ministry; agency bears return costs and is the employer under temporary employment.

items.q_id: Apakah ada pengawasan ketenagakerjaan untuk pekerjaan anda?
items.q_en: Is there labor inspection for your job?
items.do_id: Simpan nomor kantor ketenagakerjaan setempat.
items.do_en: Keep the number of the local labor office.
items.a_id: Pengawasan rumah tangga diizinkan dengan pengaman yang ditetapkan
items.a_en: Inspection of households allowed under stated safeguards
items.note_en: Inspectors may enter the employer's home with the owner's or the Public Prosecution's permission, on a complaint or reasonable evidence.

items.q_id: Ke mana anda bisa mengadu jika ada sengketa?
items.q_en: Where can you complain if there is a dispute?
items.do_id: Simpan nomor pengaduan di bawah. Bukti tertulis membantu pengaduan anda.
items.do_en: Keep the complaint numbers below. Written evidence helps your complaint.
items.a_id: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
items.a_en: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
items.note_en: Ministry settlement within two weeks; the Ministry decides claims up to AED 50,000 with review by the courts (as amended in 2023); worker lawsuits are fee-exempt and urgent; three-month limit after the end of employment.

items.q_id: Apakah anda mendapat jaminan sosial dan perlindungan kehamilan?
items.q_en: Do you get social security and maternity protection?
items.do_id: Tanyakan asuransi apa yang dibayar majikan.
items.do_en: Ask which insurance the employer pays for.
items.a_id: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
items.a_en: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
items.note_en: Employer bears medical care or health insurance and work-injury compensation; 30 days' sick leave (15 full pay, 15 half pay). No maternity leave, unemployment insurance or pension. End-of-service gratuity: art. 22 leaves it to the Cabinet and no resolution has been issued (checked 12 Nov. 2026); the often-cited 14 days a year came from the repealed Federal Law 10/2017.

items.q_en: Does the law protect you from abuse and harassment?
items.do_id: Jika terjadi kekerasan, cari tempat aman dan hubungi nomor di bawah.
items.do_en: If there is violence, get to a safe place and call a number below.
items.a_id: Ketentuan khusus dengan pemulihan
items.a_en: Specific provisions with a remedy
items.note_en: Sexual harassment, forced labor and discrimination prohibited in recruitment; employer must treat the worker with dignity and protect bodily safety.

items.q_id: Bolehkah anda bergabung dengan serikat atau perkumpulan pekerja?
items.q_en: May you join a union or workers' association?
items.do_id: Cari perkumpulan pekerja Indonesia di kota tujuan.
items.do_en: Look for an Indonesian workers' association in the city you go to.
items.a_id: Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
items.a_en: No right recognized in law
items.note_en: Not addressed in the decree-law; UAE labor law does not provide for trade unions.

items.note_en: Written contract on the Standard Unified Contract, authenticated by the ministry, bilingual (Arabic and another language).

items.q_id: Apakah upah minimum berlaku bagi anda?
items.q_en: Does a minimum wage apply to you?
items.do_id: Pastikan jumlah upah tertulis di kontrak.

items.note_en: National minimum wage (QAR 1,000 a month) applies to domestic workers, plus QAR 500 housing and QAR 300 food if not provided.

items.q_id: Apakah upah harus dibayar rutin dan tercatat?

items.do_id: Catat setiap pembayaran upah: tanggal, jumlah, dan potongan.

items.a_id: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura

items.note_en: Paid at the end of the month and no later than the third day of the next, by bank account or in cash against a signed receipt; recruitment costs may not be deducted.

items.q_id: Apakah jam kerja anda dibatasi?
items.q_en: Are your working hours limited?
items.do_id: Catat jam mulai dan selesai kerja setiap hari.
items.do_en: Write down when you start and stop work each day.
items.a_id: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

items.note_en: Law sets a 10-hour daily cap excluding breaks; the standard contract sets 8 normal hours plus up to 2 hours' overtime at 125 per cent.
items.src: Law 15/2017 art. 12; Standard Unified Contract art. 4; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

items.a_id: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi

items.note_en: Confiscating passports is an offence (fine up to QAR 25,000), but the employer may keep the passport with the worker's written consent.

items.note_en: Change of employer at any time without the employer's permission, with one or two months' notice through the ministry system (compensation capped at two months' wage during probation); no exit permit, 72 hours' notice before leaving the country.

items.q_id: Apakah anda harus mendapat kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang anda pahami?
items.q_en: Must you get a written contract in a language you understand?

items.do_en: Ask for the contract in your language. Read it before signing. Keep a photo on your phone.
items.a_id: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
items.a_en: Written contract required, no language rule
items.note_en: Contract on the form prescribed by the Domestic Workers Department, in English and Arabic (not necessarily a language the worker understands); renewable annually.

items.q_id: Apakah upah minimum berlaku bagi anda?
items.q_en: Does a minimum wage apply to you?

items.do_en: Make sure the wage is written in the contract.
items.a_id: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain
items.a_en: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
items.note_en: Minimum wage of KWD 75 a month, the same figure as for the private sector.

items.q_id: Apakah upah harus dibayar rutin dan tercatat?
items.q_en: Must your wage be paid regularly and on record?

items.do_en: Write down every payment: date, amount and deductions.
items.a_id: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
items.a_en: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
items.note_en: Monthly, within seven days of the due date, against a receipt; KWD 10 penalty for each month of delay.

items.q_id: Apakah jam kerja anda dibatasi?
items.q_en: Are your working hours limited?

items.do_en: Write down when you start and stop work each day.
items.a_id: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
items.a_en: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
items.note_en: Up to 12 hours a day including breaks; the standard contract adds an hour's rest after five hours and 8 consecutive hours of night rest; up to two extra hours paid at half a day's wage.

items.q_id: Apakah anda berhak libur mingguan?
items.q_en: Do you have a right to a weekly day off?

items.a_en: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
items.note_en: One day per week.

items.q_id: Apakah anda berhak cuti tahunan dibayar?

items.q_id: Apakah ada aturan tentang tempat tinggal dan privasi anda?

items.a_en: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met

items.note_en: Monthly payment; domestic workers are outside the Wages Protection Scheme unless the employer opts in.
items.src: Law 36/2012 art. 2; Decision 68/2019; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

items.q_id: Apakah jam kerja anda dibatasi?
items.q_en: Are your working hours limited?
items.do_id: Catat jam mulai dan selesai kerja setiap hari.
items.do_en: Write down when you start and stop work each day.
items.a_id: Tidak ada batas dan aturan istirahat harian
items.a_en: No limit and no daily rest rule
items.note_en: Working hours not specified.

items.q_id: Apakah anda berhak libur mingguan?
items.q_en: Do you have a right to a weekly day off?
items.do_id: Pastikan hari libur tertulis di kontrak.
items.do_en: Make sure your day off is written in the contract.
items.a_id: Tidak ada istirahat mingguan
items.a_en: No weekly rest
items.note_en: Weekly rest not specified.

items.q_id: Apakah anda berhak cuti tahunan dibayar?
items.q_en: Do you have a right to paid annual leave?
items.do_id: Tanyakan berapa hari cuti anda per tahun.
items.do_en: Ask how many days of leave you get each year.
items.a_id: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
items.a_en: Equal to or longer than for other workers
items.note_en: 30 days' annual leave.

items.q_id: Apakah anda boleh menyimpan paspor sendiri?
items.q_en: May you keep your own passport?
items.do_id: Simpan foto paspor, visa, dan kontrak di HP dan kirim ke keluarga.
items.do_en: Keep photos of your passport, visa and contract on your phone and send them to your family.
items.a_id: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
items.a_en: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
items.note_en: Employers may not confiscate passports.
items.src: Penal Code art. 395; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

items.q_id: Apakah ada aturan tentang tempat tinggal dan privasi anda?
items.q_en: Are there rules on your living conditions and privacy?
items.do_id: Tanyakan di mana anda akan tidur dan apakah ada kamar sendiri.
items.do_en: Ask where you will sleep and whether you get your own room.
items.a_id: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
items.a_en: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
items.note_en: The standard contract requires decent housing, privacy, food, clothing, safety, medical care and regular contact with family.
items.src: LMRA standard contract; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

items.q_id: Bisakah anda pindah majikan?
items.q_en: Can you change employer?
items.do_id: Jika tidak bisa pindah tanpa izin majikan, pastikan majikan dan pekerjaan sesuai janji sebelum berangkat.
items.do_en: If you cannot change without the employer's consent, check the employer and the job before you leave.
items.a_id: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
items.a_en: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
items.note_en: Change of employer at any time with permission; without it, only with LMRA approval. Domestic workers have one week (others 30 days) to contest an absconding report.

items.q_id: Apakah biaya perekrutan dilarang di negara tujuan?
items.q_en: Are recruitment fees banned in the destination?
items.do_id: Jangan membayar agen di luar ketentuan. Minta kuitansi untuk setiap pembayaran.
items.do_en: Do not pay agents more than the rules allow. Get a receipt for every payment.
items.a_id: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
items.a_en: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
items.note_en: No person may take money or any benefit from a worker for a work permit, employment or keeping the job; prison of 3 months to 1 year and/or BHD 1,000-2,000, aggravated for domestic-worker permits and multiplied by the number of workers.

items.q_id: Apakah agen harus berizin dan bertanggung jawab?
items.q_en: Must agencies be licensed and liable?
items.do_id: Catat nama dan nomor izin agen di Indonesia dan di negara tujuan.
items.do_en: Write down the name and licence number of the agency at home and abroad.
items.a_id: Hanya perizinan
items.a_en: Licensing only
items.note_en: LMRA licence with Bahraini ownership, approved contract templates and a BHD 10,000 guarantee (which compensates employers only); offices placing women domestic workers must provide temporary housing supervised by a woman.

items.q_id: Apakah ada pengawasan ketenagakerjaan untuk pekerjaan anda?
items.q_en: Is there labor inspection for your job?
items.do_id: Simpan nomor kantor ketenagakerjaan setempat.
items.do_en: Keep the number of the local labor office.
items.a_id: Tidak ada pengawasan
items.a_en: No inspection
items.note_en: No household inspection.

items.q_id: Ke mana anda bisa mengadu jika ada sengketa?
items.q_en: Where can you complain if there is a dispute?
items.do_id: Simpan nomor pengaduan di bawah. Bukti tertulis membantu pengaduan anda.
items.do_en: Keep the complaint numbers below. Written evidence helps your complaint.
items.a_id: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
items.a_en: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
items.note_en: Ministry settlement or direct LMRA filing with translation and document help; no filing fee; hearing within two months.

items.q_id: Apakah anda mendapat jaminan sosial dan perlindungan kehamilan?
items.q_en: Do you get social security and maternity protection?
items.do_id: Tanyakan asuransi apa yang dibayar majikan.
items.do_en: Ask which insurance the employer pays for.
items.a_id: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
items.a_en: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
items.note_en: Compulsory private health insurance includes domestic workers; end-of-service gratuity applies; sick leave, injury and maternity not specified; optional employer insurance.
items.src: Law 23/2018 art. 26; Law 36/2012 art. 2; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

items.q_id: Apakah hukum melindungi anda dari kekerasan dan pelecehan?
items.q_en: Does the law protect you from abuse and harassment?
items.do_id: Jika terjadi kekerasan, cari tempat aman dan hubungi nomor di bawah.
items.do_en: If there is violence, get to a safe place and call a number below.
items.a_id: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum
items.a_en: General criminal or civil law only
items.note_en: LMRA Expatriate Protection Unit shelter for trafficking victims; hotline 995; general criminal law.

items.q_id: Bolehkah anda bergabung dengan serikat atau perkumpulan pekerja?
items.q_en: May you join a union or workers' association?
items.do_id: Cari perkumpulan pekerja Indonesia di kota tujuan.
items.do_en: Look for an Indonesian workers' association in the city you go to.
items.a_id: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat
items.a_en: May form and join trade unions
items.note_en: All workers, including domestic workers, may join and in principle form trade unions.

help.d: Advice, legal and medical help and repatriation support for migrant workers. Office hours Sunday to Thursday, 8am to 1pm. Its shelter closed in 2019.
help.d_id: Nasihat, bantuan hukum dan medis, serta dukungan pemulangan bagi pekerja migran. Jam kantor Minggu sampai Kamis, pukul 08.00 sampai 13.00. Rumah aman mereka tutup pada 2019.

help.d: Bahrain's Labour Market Regulatory Authority runs a 24-hour hotline in several languages for workers who are abused, trafficked or not paid. The center also offers shelter.
help.d_id: Otoritas Pasar Kerja Bahrain mengelola saluran 24 jam dalam beberapa bahasa bagi pekerja yang dianiaya, diperdagangkan atau tidak dibayar. Pusat ini juga menyediakan tempat penampungan.

before.id: Berangkat lewat jalur resmi. Periksa izin perusahaan penempatan (P3MI) di situs KP2MI (dulu BP2MI) sebelum menyerahkan dokumen atau uang.
before.en: Leave through official channels. Check the placement company's licence on the KP2MI (formerly BP2MI) website before handing over documents or money.

before.id: Simpan foto paspor, visa, kontrak, dan kuitansi di HP, dan kirim salinannya ke keluarga.
before.en: Keep photos of your passport, visa, contract and receipts on your phone, and send copies to your family.

before.id: Tanda tangani perjanjian kerja sebelum berangkat, di depan petugas. Baca isinya dan minta salinannya.
before.en: Sign the employment contract before you leave, in front of an official. Read it and ask for a copy.

before.id: Untuk 10 jabatan, termasuk pekerja rumah tangga, anda tidak boleh dibebani biaya penempatan. Tanyakan apakah pekerjaan anda termasuk.
before.en: For 10 occupations, including domestic work, you must not be charged placement costs. Ask whether your job is one of them.

before.id: Ikuti Orientasi Pra Pemberangkatan (OPP). Ini wajib dan gratis.
before.en: Attend the pre-departure orientation. It is compulsory and free.

before.id: Pastikan anda terdaftar di BPJS Ketenagakerjaan sebelum berangkat, dan simpan nomor kartunya.
before.en: Make sure you are registered with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan before you leave, and keep the card number.

before.id: Catat alamat KBRI atau KJRI di negara tujuan. Nomor resminya ada di aplikasi Safe Travel Kementerian Luar Negeri.
before.en: Write down the address of the Indonesian embassy or consulate. Its official numbers are in the Foreign Ministry's Safe Travel app.

before.id: Penempatan PRT pada majikan perseorangan di 19 negara Timur Tengah dihentikan sejak 2015, kecuali jalur resmi uji coba ke Arab Saudi. Tawaran di luar jalur resmi berisiko tinggi.
before.en: Placement of domestic workers with private employers in 19 Middle East countries has been suspended since 2015, except a pilot official channel to Saudi Arabia. Offers outside official channels are high-risk.

home_help.city: Jakarta, with branches in sending districts
home_help.city_id: Jakarta, dengan cabang di daerah asal pekerja
home_help.d: A union run by migrant workers and former migrant workers. Takes complaints about recruitment fraud, unpaid wages and trafficking, and has branches in districts such as Indramayu.
home_help.d_id: Serikat yang dijalankan oleh pekerja migran dan mantan pekerja migran. Menerima pengaduan tentang penipuan perekrutan, upah tidak dibayar dan perdagangan orang, dengan cabang di daerah seperti Indramayu.

home_help.d: Advocacy organization for Indonesian migrant workers. Takes up individual cases and works with villages that send many workers abroad.
home_help.d_id: Organisasi advokasi untuk pekerja migran Indonesia. Menangani kasus perorangan dan bekerja dengan desa yang banyak mengirim pekerja ke luar negeri.

home_help.n: KP2MI (Ministry for the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers)
home_help.d: The government body that licenses recruitment agencies and receives complaints against them. Use its official website for the current complaint channel.
home_help.d_id: Lembaga pemerintah yang memberi izin kepada perusahaan penempatan (P3MI) dan menerima pengaduan terhadapnya. Gunakan situs resminya untuk saluran pengaduan terbaru.
